pages.title: Race Won
pages.text: Plays when you finish in the top five and move on to the next city. Then the bonuses are counted: Race, Thrash, Trick, Skitchin', Police and Warp. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Warp
pages.text: A tip in the game: 'I once jumped into a billboard, and somehow warped to another city. I can't remember where that billboard was though.' The warp has a sound of its own.

pages.title: Later
pages.text: Jeff went on to Need for Speed with guitarist Saki Kaskas, won a BAFTA in 2001 for Shogun: Total War, and led the audio of Alien: Isolation, a BAFTA winner too.
